name: Marico Ltd.
business_summary: Parachute coconut oil (about 60% share of branded coconut oil per Open Magazine 2026-11-03), Saffola edible oils and foods, value-added hair oils (Nihar, Hair & Care), Set Wet, Livon, digital-first brands (Beardo, Just Herbs, Plix acquisition reported Oct 2026) and international (Bangladesh, Vietnam, MENA, South Africa) ~25% of revenue (approximate). FY26 margin compressed to ~15% when copra spiked; copra has since eased ~35% from peak (ET 2026-11-02). Q2 FY27: Parachute volume growth at a 22-quarter high; FY27 growth and margin guidance raised.

revenue_mix.segment: India: value-added hair oils & personal care

exposures.mechanism: Copra ~28% of costs (approximate, model knowledge); costs ~82% of sales. +15% copra => costs +4.2% => 3.4% of sales => EBITDA -19% at 18% margin; Marico repices within 1-2 quarters (~60% passthrough) => -7.6; persistence 0.5; EV/MCap ~0.97 => -3.8. Realised both ways: FY26 margin ~15% on copra spike; copra -35% from peak (ET 2026-11-02) drove the Q2 profit growth that was a 51-quarter high (CNBC TV18).

evidence.note: ET: Marico sees copra prices ease 35% from peak, crude-linked costs and vegetable oil inflation pose risks

exposures.mechanism: Safflower/rice-bran/sunflower oils for Saffola ~10% of costs. +10% => costs +1.0% => 0.82% of sales => EBITDA -4.6%; 50% pass-through => -2.3; persistence 0.5 => -1.1. Empirical -0.58 (t=-0.7). Duty cut on 24 Sep 2026 partially helps.
HDPE bottles, cartons ~10% of costs. +10% => costs +1.0% => EBITDA -4.6%... 50% passthrough, 0.5 persistence, overlap with crude-linked => -0.8.

Light liquid paraffin (hair oils) and chemicals ~6% of costs, crude-linked: +10% Brent => +6% input => costs +0.36% => 0.3% of sales => EBITDA -1.6%; 50% passthrough, persistence 0.5 => -0.4. Empirical -0.39 (t=-1.0) agrees. ET Nov 2026 flags crude-linked cost risk.

Rural is a large share of Parachute/ hair-oil demand (~45% of India, approximate). +5pp rural => India volume +2pp x 0.75 India share, 40% incremental margin/18% => EBITDA +3.3%... persistence 0.5 => +1.7 rounded to +2.0 given the Q2 rural rebound.

evidence.note: Business Standard: higher volumes, profit growth guidance positive

exposures.mechanism: Foods, premium hair care and digital-first brands skew urban (~30% of India). +5pp urban => EBITDA +2.4% x 0.5 persistence => +1.2.

evidence.note: digital-first and foods drive growth per BusinessLine 2026-11-02

exposures.mechanism: International (~25% revenue) translates into more INR when INR weakens, but local currencies (BDT, VND, EGP) are also under pressure; imported oils/paraffin offset. Net +0.4, low confidence. Empirical -0.61 (t=-0.5) insignificant.
P/E ~60 on reported EPS; net cash. +25bp repo => ~-1.2 on valuation duration.
Foods (Saffola, Gruhshree), digital-first brands (Plix, Beardo) lift mix; +1 => mix adds ~0.7pp margin => EBITDA +3.5% x persistence 1.0 x 0.3 haircut => +1.0.

supply_chain.counterparty: Coconut farmers / copra traders (Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka)
